text:
alex: CI turned red on master right after yesterday's toolchain image bump. Failing unit is //runtime:executor_test on linux-fastbuild shard, compile error looks like a linker runtime symbol issue. Anyone else seeing this?

ci-bot: Build failed: //runtime:executor_test (compile) — see https://ci/repo/job/8745 for logs

michelle: yup saw it on my feature branch too. Log excerpt: `undefined reference to __atomic_fetch_add_8` during link. Appears only on linux shards.

alex: copying relevant chunk from the log: ```/usr/bin/ld: libexecutor.a(executor.o): in function `Executor::incCounter()': executor.cpp:(.text+0x1a): undefined reference to `__atomic_fetch_add_8' collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status```

samir: suspecting the new gcc image changed default linker flags / stripped libatomic when LTO is enabled. Could be missing -latomic on some cc_binary.

olivia: I can't repro on mac. All mac lanes green. Looks limited to linux toolchain.

michelle: I kicked a local reproduce with `bazel test //runtime:executor_test --config=linux --test_output=errors` on ubuntu20 image, it reproduces.

samir: can someone trigger a bisect on the toolchain image? If it's the image bump we should be able to pinpoint which layer introduced the change. @eng-infra tagging you.

ci-bot: Bisect job queued: https://ci/repo/bisect/IMG-ROLL-2026-09 (owner: eng-infra)

alex: short-term unblock: adding explicit `linkopts = ["-latomic"]` to cc_library that produces libexecutor seems likely to fix. Not ideal but buys time. Can we land a workaround PR and follow up with toolchain fix?

michelle: I'll open a tiny PR with the linkopts workaround and trigger a full CI run. If tests pass we can merge and then revert once toolchain is fixed.

olivia: please add a short note in the rollout ticket so the owner knows we introduced a temporary workaround.

samir: I'll start triage for the root cause: checking whether LTO flags or new binutils shipped in the image dropped atomic support. Also will try building with `-fno-lto` to confirm.

michelle: PR created: 1287 — `runtime: add -latomic workaround` (CI queued).

ci-bot: Tests queued for PR 1287. Estimated ~12m to first results.

oncall-eng-infra: Ack'd. If bisect confirms image regression we'll schedule an image rollback or rebuild. Will keep you posted in this thread. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — @samir please update INFRA-321 with findings, and @michelle thanks for the fast PR. We'll merge the workaround if all linux shards pass.

michelle: linux shards passed on PR CI, merging now. Will follow up with a revert PR once image fix lands.

samir: bisect shows regression introduced in image layer that upgraded binutils -> 2.40. Opening a rollback + rebuild ticket.

oncall-eng-infra: rollback ticket INFRA-334 created, linking INFRA-321. Scheduling hotfix image build.

alex: good work everyone. We'll keep the workaround short-lived. Moving ops conversation to the infra ticket but ping here if anything regresses.
